where.if: AND ( cnname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{like}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{like}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{like}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT name, cnname, caseAmount, difficulty, tags, authors, createtime, updateat, content, freq, public > 0 AS publicProblem, solution, showsolution FROM problem WHERE name = #{name}
AND public = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem (name, cnname, caseAmount, difficulty, tags, authors, createtime, updateat, content, freq, public, solution, showsolution) VALUES (#{name}, #{cnname}, #{caseAmount}, #{difficulty}, #{tags}, #{authors}, #{createtime}, #{updateat}, #{content}, #{freq}, #{publicProblem}, #{solution}, #{showsolution})
mapper.update: UPDATE problem SET cnname = #{cnname}, caseAmount = #{caseAmount}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, tags = #{tags}, authors = #{authors}, updateat = #{updateat}, content = #{content}, freq = #{freq}, public = #{publicProblem}, solution = #{solution}, showsolution = #{showsolution} WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record (traceId, userName, cnname, problemName, language, code, result, timeUsed, memoryUsed, submitTime) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{userName}, #{cnname}, #{problemName}, #{language}, #{code}, #{result}, #{timeUsed}, #{memoryUsed}, #{submitTime})
mapper.select: SELECT problem_name FROM correct WHERE user_name = #{userName}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM correct WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND problem_name = #{problemName}
